text.title: Air travel
text.body_text: Air travel is the process of going from place to place by any flying object, such as airplanes, helicopters, balloons, or anything that can fly. Air travel has been a human wish since the ancient age. People seeing birds flying tried to take flight in many ways. At the end of the 18th century the Montgolifer brothers invented balloons made for travel, and at the beginning of the 20th the Wright brothers invented airplanes. Air travel has since been made much faster. Today we can think of going around the world in 24 hours, which was never possible with any other type of transport. Today air travel is a normal way to travel, for pleasure, personal need or business. Air travel can be broadly put into two groups; domestic flights, and international flights. Air travel within a country are called domestic flights. Most countries have domestic airlines to provide this service. Air travel across the borders of countries are called international flights. Long distance air travel is mostly international. == Related pages == Airline Airport
